# Pinned Robbo engine

These unmodified engine, application and generated campaign sources are copied from
https://github.com/robbo-game/robbo at commit
24109cdb2d0f9438a8f6dc07ce227072446adac3 (engine robbo-java-3).

They are compiled only into the isolated verifier worker and its tests. No DOM,
rendering, browser storage, credentials or frontend build output is included.
Keep the pinned revision explicit when updating; existing results remain separated
by engine version and campaign digest. Original authorship metadata is retained.
